Subject: HZN-549 Horizon Health — Sales->CS handoff: staging constraints & sprint0 owners

Team — sharing the handoff for Horizon Health (deal HZN-549). Quick summary and asks below.

Deal snapshot:
- ARR: $360k first year (annual commit)
- Product: Hosted inference + Dedicated pool during pilot, plan to migrate to Dedicated for prod
- Target go-live (prod): 2027-01-18 (customer expectation)

Key constraints called out by Horizon during procurement:
1) Data residency: must keep logs/usage in us-west-2. No external log exports without DPA.
2) VPC peering + cross-account role required for staging; they want a pre-approved CloudFormation role template.
3) SOC2 evidence & pen-test report needed before production sign-off (we'll provide SOC2 Type II and pen-test summary).
4) Expected traffic for pilot: ~50 concurrent rps, peaks up to 200 rps during scheduled batch jobs. Average token size ~350 tokens/request.

Attached: SOW draft (SOW_HZN-549_v0.3.pdf), infra diagram (infra_diagram_v2.png).

Primary asks for CS:
- Assign primary CS owner and security/infra lead to coordinate the staging window and access.
- Confirm whether we can provision a Dedicated pool in us-west-2 for pilot (cost/lead time notes included in SOW).
- Kickoff: proposed week of Oct 12 — want to lock a 60-minute technical kickoff with Horizon infra + PM.

Internal notes for CS team: Horizon's infra lead is responsive but strict on IAM scoping. They may require an air-gapped staging subnet for encrypted payloads in the pilot. Procurement asked for a 30-day rollback clause in the SOW; legal flagged it as negotiable.

Ben

Thanks Ben — appreciate the concise handoff. Quick take and owner assignments below.

Assignment (proposed):
- Primary CS owner (Technical PM / Lead): Karthik Iyer — will run kickoff, SOW acceptance items, and staging plan.
- Security & compliance lead: Monica Patel — will own SOC2 evidence, pen-test coordination, and DPA questions.
- Ops contact (on-call during staging): Grace O'Connor (me) — will coordinate infra scheduling with Horizon and Redwood infra.

Initial plan (sprint0):
- Oct 13: 60-min technical kickoff (Horizon PM + infra + Redwood CS + infra).
- Oct 14–22: Staging window to provision Dedicated pool in us-west-2; complete cross-account role and prefix/KV cache validation.
- Acceptance: smoke test (latency < 250ms p50 for 350-token median) + ingestion of 10k sample requests (test data provided by Horizon).

Requests back to Ben / Horizon:
1) Ben — please confirm Horizon can provide a cross-account role ARN with AdministratorAttach privileges for initial staging (we will lock down later). If they only want scoped permissions, request their exact policy.
2) Horizon — please share SSO/SP metadata and the expected daily request volume shape (burst pattern vs steady).

I'll take the kickoff scheduling action. Karthik, can you confirm availability and whether we need a longer kickoff with infra deep-dive?

Grace
